about_the_game:
An Epic Text-Based RPG Adventure with Strategy and Mini-Games

Step Into a Dark and Dangerous Fantasy World

Dive into an immersive text-based RPG that blends rich storytelling with vivid visual elements and a variety of interactive mini-games. Navigate through a brutal fantasy world teeming with mythical creatures and menacing monsters as you make crucial choices that shape your unique adventure.

Begin your journey in a peaceful village, then traverse treacherous roads, shadowy forests, and vibrant cities. Climb icy mountains, raid orc encampments, and uncover hidden secrets — all guided by atmospheric artwork and ambient audio that bring the world to life.

*Engage in intense 1v1 RPG-like battles.*

Forge Your Path and Define Your Role

Create your own identity with a flexible character system. Whether you prefer swinging a heavy battle axe, sneaking through shadows, or using mysterious magic scrolls found in ancient ruins — your playstyle is entirely your own.

Meet a diverse cast of characters including humans, elves, dwarves, and orcs. Engage in tactical combat, bargain with mercenary knights, and make impactful decisions that influence the evolving story. Survive, gather gold to upgrade your equipment, and overcome the many threats that await.

*Test your wits in a tactical, chess-like strategic mini-game.*

Discover Fun and Risky Mini-Games

Spice up your adventure with various mini-games such as drinking duels, dice rolls, lockpicking, coin flipping, and card matches. Each mini-game provides additional layers of challenge, rewards, and immersion.

*Roll the dice in tavern games — sometimes luck is your only ally.*

Choose Your Way to Play — Story or Survival

For those seeking a hardcore experience, iron mode offers a relentless survival challenge where every decision could be your last. Prefer a more relaxed approach? Save often and enjoy the branching narrative at your own pace.

With its deep non-linear storyline, rich worldbuilding, and dynamic gameplay, this text-based RPG offers a one-of-a-kind fantasy experience.
